svg.font-family: 'Space Grotesk', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif
svg.title: absentia capabilities and required inputs
svg.desc: v0.1 ships index, check, verify and mcp, JSON output for check and verify, exit codes 0, 3 and 4, lexical plus semantic scoring combined with max, and deterministic variants. The operator brings Python 3.12, an archive directory with a text layer, a Chinese claim and an optional local embedding endpoint using bge-m3 by default. Not included: OCR, incremental indexing, xlsx workpapers, batch concurrency, a non-Chinese lexicon and a hosted API.
